amos.9.p1.b1.text: I saw the Lord standing beside the altar, and He said: “Strike the tops of the pillars so that the thresholds shake. … None of those who flee will get away; none of the fugitives will escape.

amos.9.p1.b2.text: Though they dig down to Sheol, from there My hand will take them; and though they climb up to heaven, from there I will pull them down.

amos.9.p1.b3.text: Though they hide themselves atop Carmel, there I will track them and seize them; … I will fix My eyes upon them for harm and not for good.”

amos.9.p1.b4.text: The Lord GOD of Hosts, He who touches the earth and it melts, … He builds His upper rooms in the heavens and founds His vault upon the earth. He summons the waters of the sea and pours them over the face of the earth. The LORD is His name.

amos.9.p1.b5.text: … Did I not bring Israel up from the land of Egypt, the Philistines from Caphtor, and the Arameans from Kir?

amos.9.p1.b6.text: … Yet I will not utterly destroy the house of Jacob,” declares the LORD.

amos.9.p1.b7.text: “For surely I will give the command, and I will shake the house of Israel among all the nations as grain is sifted in a sieve; but not a pebble will reach the ground.

amos.9.p2.b1.text: “In that day I will restore the fallen tent of David. I will repair its gaps, restore its ruins, and rebuild it as in the days of old,

amos.9.p2.b2.text: “Behold, the days are coming,” declares the LORD, “when the plowman will overtake the reaper and the treader of grapes, the sower of seed. The mountains will drip with sweet wine, with which all the hills will flow.

amos.9.p2.b3.text: I will restore My people Israel from captivity; they will rebuild and inhabit the ruined cities. They will plant vineyards and drink their wine; they will make gardens and eat their fruit.

amos.9.p2.b4.text: I will firmly plant them in their own land, never again to be uprooted from the land that I have given them,” says the LORD your God.
